response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS all_album_avg FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond, a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - o.all_album_avg AS above_all_album_avg FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY above_all_album_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
